name: clip_to_region
description: Clip a spatial artifact, such as a climate layer, to a selected region. The region can be provided either as a region name or as a region artifact returned by resolve_region.

input_artifact.description: A spatial artifact containing a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Usually returned by load_climate_projection.

region_name.description: Optional region name to clip to, such as 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia', or 'Pacific Island Countries and Territories'. Required if region_artifact is not supplied.

region_artifact.description: Optional region artifact returned by resolve_region. If provided, this is used instead of resolving region_name again.

keep_empty.description: If false, return a failure artifact when clipping produces no features. If true, return a clipped_layer artifact with zero features.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input layer.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

region_name.description: Resolved region name used for clipping.

admin_level.description: Administrative level of the clipping region.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

value_column.description: Main numeric column to use for downstream analysis.

provenance.description: Information about the clipping method, region resolution, and parent artifact provenance.
